location_address: 1641 QUIVIRA RD San Diego, CA US 92109
description: Hop on board our Party Cat with your friends and family for our ticketed sunset cruise through Mission Bay! With a 24 passenger maximum, bring your friends and family for a chance to mingle with the other passengers over sunset, beverages, and great music!
what_is_included:
- 2 hour sunset cruise in Mission Bay
- All ages
- BYOB 

Don't want to stop at the store on your way? We sell a variety of beer, seltzers, wine, and N/A beverages at our storefront!
what_is_not_included: Interested in privately chartering the boat for you and your group? Call us at 619-223-7584 to chat about our private charter opportunities!
